about: G6 reads this in every gate. `devenv shell -- audit-freeze journeys` writes it; a feature adds its new tasks with `devenv shell -- audit-freeze add`, which leaves every row here as it is.

tasks.task: Play the planned NPC: read Warden Ostrel
The party attacks Warden Ostrel: start the fight
Roll and begin the fight with Warden Ostrel
Warden Ostrel gives up: end the fight
He gave up, and the party holds him: a line in his Log
Close the fight, keep the rewards, and add loot nobody planned
Two days overland: roll for encounters on the road
The second day names the Wolf Pack: plan it and start it
Roll and begin the Wolf Pack fight
Put the Wolf Pack fight's rewards in the note
Mark the talk with Warden Ostrel done, and log what happened
